name: Проклятие! Потеря большой шмотки
alt: Огромный топор уносит невероятно маленький розовый шарик.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one square original illustration for a humorous fantasy card game, readable at 384 by 384 pixels. Funny expressive caricature, bold clean ink outlines, loose watercolor and gouache on warm parchment, colorful accents. One obvious visual joke, simple chunky shapes, minimal background, centered large subject with comfortable margins. Modest detail, no intricate scenery. No text, letters, digits, logos, watermark, border or card frame. Clear anatomy, no extra limbs. Subject: A tiny adult fantasy adventurer stares in disbelief as an enormous two-handed axe floats away attached to one absurdly small pink balloon. Adventurer two empty hands raised clearly apart, weapon much larger than character.
